scope: CPU read-only review, not an execution authorization or experiment result
evidence_limit: Per-epoch logs lack base-only/mismatched Dice, backbone parameter/output drift and loss-specific backbone gradient decomposition. Nonzero query total gradient proves common adaptation, not that base drift caused lower Dice.
independent_design_basis: Hold the nearly all-performing e164 base and ungated proposal fixed. Gate targets become stationary for identical augmented input; isolate a 34-parameter utility calibration from joint feature/base/proposal co-adaptation.
recommendation: Mechanistically defensible as the only second candidate if root precommits it; not empirically necessary or guaranteed better, and not justified by GPU idleness or score alone.
resource_assessment: 80 rounds is plausible inside remaining initial24h using full80 measured runtime as conservative proxy, but no gate-only CUDA measurement exists; full synthetic timing/memory and new budget freeze required before training.
